sources.title: Renault brand achieves +10% global passenger car sales growth in 2025, driven by successful product offensive

sources.title: 40 CFR 86.1806-17 — Onboard diagnostics
sources.quote: For a 0.020 inch leak, the DTC(s) shall be a generic SAE J2012 DTC that is specific to an EVAP system very small leak (e.g., P0456, P04EE, or P04EF) or an equivalent manufacturer-specific DTC that we approve.
